# Consider Chapter 13

> A comprehensive Chapter 13 bankruptcy education platform offering professional training, legal resources, and industry networking for attorneys, trustees, and nonprofit organizations.

Consider Chapter 13 (NACTT Academy) serves as the leading educational resource for Chapter 13 bankruptcy professionals through webinars, conferences, articles, and membership programs. The platform aggregates curated content on bankruptcy law, student loans, economic trends, and regulatory updates from the US Trustee and federal courts.

## Key Topics

- Chapter 13 bankruptcy
- Bankruptcy law and code
- Continuing legal education
- Chapter 13 professionals
- Trustee education
- Attorney membership
- Student loan policy
- US Trustee guidance
- Supreme Court decisions
- Subchapter V
- Bankruptcy conference
- Consumer bankruptcy education
- Credit reporting
- Means testing
- Bankruptcy fraud

## Membership & Registration

- [Join The Academy](https://considerchapter13.org/join-the-academy): Membership enrollment page with subscription plans for attorneys, trustees, and nonprofits
- [Attorney Subscription](https://considerchapter13.org/attorney-subscription): Annual attorney subscription registration for NACTT Academy membership
- [Trustee Subscription](https://considerchapter13.org/trustee-subscription): Annual trustee subscription registration for Chapter 13 professionals
- [Government | Non-Profit Subscription](https://considerchapter13.org/gov-subscription): Government and nonprofit organization membership registration and pricing
- [Meet the Academy](https://considerchapter13.org/meet-the-academy): NACTT Academy mission, leadership, and membership benefits overview

## Educational Resources & Training

- [2025 Conference Recordings](https://considerchapter13.org/2025-conference-recordings): Purchase 2025 Chicago Conference recordings on Chapter 13 bankruptcy topics
- [Public Articles](https://considerchapter13.org/articles/public): Public bankruptcy law articles on Chapter 13, student loans, and evidentiary issues
- [Subchapter V Resources](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/sub-v): Subchapter V bankruptcy law resources, debt limits, and trustee litigation guidance

## Regulatory & Legal Updates

- [From the UST](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/from-the-ust): US Trustee announcements, means testing, criminal referrals, and program updates
- [From the Supreme Court](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/from-the-supreme-court): Supreme Court bankruptcy decisions, consumer protection rulings, and legal analysis
- [Of Interest](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/of-interest): Bankruptcy news, case law analysis, and litigation updates of professional interest

## Specialized Topics

- [Student Loans Chronicles](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/student-loans-chronicles): Student loan news, repayment plans, forgiveness programs, and policy updates
- [Debt and the Economy](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/debt-and-the-economy): Curated articles on household debt, economic impacts, and consumer financial hardship
- [Sanctions and Irony and Fraud, Oh My!](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/sanctions-and-irony-and-fraud-oh-my): Bankruptcy fraud case studies, false statements, and federal crime discussions

## Career Opportunities

- [Positions Available](https://considerchapter13.org/positions-available): Job listings for judicial positions, trustee roles, and internships in bankruptcy courts

## Optional Resources

- [For Your Blog](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/for-your-blog): Curated bankruptcy and financial content for professional blogs and resources
- [For Your Health](https://considerchapter13.org/external-link-topics/for-your-health): Health and wellness resources and lifestyle information for members
